\subsection*{Trinity anchor}

The Trinity identity $\varphi^2 + \varphi^{-2} = 3$ underwrites the
numerical scaffolding of every chapter in this monograph. Since
$\varphi = (1+\sqrt{5})/2$ and $\varphi^{-1} = (\sqrt{5}-1)/2$, the sum of
their squares satisfies
\[
\varphi^2 + \varphi^{-2} = (1 + \varphi) + (2 - \varphi) = 3,
\]
(using $\varphi^2 = \varphi + 1$ and $\varphi^{-2} = 2 - \varphi$).
The associated Zenodo deposition DOI is
\filepath{10.5281/zenodo.19227877}; the ORCID of record for the principal
author (Dmitrii Vasilev) is
\texttt{0009-0008-4294-6159}. Every theorem in the monograph that names
the cube identity $27 = 3^3 = (\varphi^2 + \varphi^{-2})^3$ resolves
against this anchor.
